QuestInfo.name: A Box with Goodies Inside
QuestInfo.1: #p1102007#, after telling you about acquiring items from boxes, has asked that you collect #b#t4032267##k and #b#t4032268##k from the boxes scattered around the field. He says you can only break the boxes using #bregular attacks#k.
QuestInfo.2: Upon receiving #t4032267# and #t4032268#, #p1102007# made you a fantastic chair using the materials. If you continue to your left, you'll meet the last brother, #p1102008#. Let's rush over.

item.0: It seems you haven't acquired the #b#t4032267##k and #b#t4032268##k yet. You can get them by #bbreaking the boxes scattered around the field using your regular attack#k. Come on, you can do it.
